body: The Alpha onboarding runbook lists the steps operators follow to bring a new tenant online, including the rollout checklist prerequisites.
The Alpha rollout checklist enumerates the launch gates: staging bake, canary cohort, and the go/no-go signoff required before general availability.
Dana owns the Beta workstream and is the directly responsible individual for its dependencies and its launch signoff.
The checkout outage postmortem records the root cause as permission cache invalidation during a checkout deployment window.
The release is blocked on the authentication service dependency; the rollout owner is waiting on the auth team before proceeding.
The billing migration moves invoices from the legacy ledger to the new metering pipeline, and freezes writes during the cutover.
The reliability SLO dashboard tracks latency and error budget burn for checkout, search, and billing surfaces.
During the 2023 winter incident the search index fell behind and stale results were served until the rebuild completed.
In the 2024 spring incident a bad ranking deploy lowered recall until it was rolled back the same day.
The on-call rotation assigns a primary and secondary responder each week and documents the escalation path to the incident commander.
The data retention policy keeps audit logs for one year and expires ephemeral session records after thirty days.
The vendor contract for the embedding provider caps monthly request volume and requires thirty days notice before termination.
